question: Who among the following won the Male Sportsperson of the Year Award at the FICCI India Sports Awards in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bajrang Punia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **On 10th December 2020 **Federation of Indian Commerce and Industry virtually presented India Sports Awards 2020, to sports personalities for their outstanding contributions in the field of sports.
 
• **Wrestler Bajrang Punia and Shooter Elavenil Valarivan** received the highest honour "Sportsperson of the Year of Men & Female" Award respectively.
 
• **FICCI (Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry)**
 
 
• The sports awards are an attempt by the industry body, Federation of Indian Commerce and Industry (FICCI) to acknowledge and recognize the contribution of sportspersons and various stakeholders who deliver excellent results throughout the year.
 
• **It is Established in 1927.**
 
• **President**- Sanjiv Mehta(As of September 2022)
 
• **Headquarter** - New Delhi, Delhi
 
 
 
• **Bajrang Punia**__
 
 
• Bajrang Punia is an **Indian freestyle wrestler.**
 
• He competes in the 65-kg weight category.
 
• At the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, Punia won a **bronze medal** by defeating Kazakhstan's Daulet Niyabekov with a wide 8-0 margin.
 
• Punia is the only Indian wrestler to win 3 medals at the World Wrestling Championship.
